## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any compatibility changes.
Link the agreed issue for a bug fix, new feature, substantial refactor, or interface
or architecture change. Small tweaks and documentation improvements may be proposed
directly; see [Contributing](https://github.com/giovannijecha/jecode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Validation

List the checks actually run, including operating system and toolchain.
State any relevant checks that remain untested.
